about.imgAlt: Visitors at Ocoa Bay's Casa Club overlooking the Caribbean — wine tasting experience in the Dominican Republic
about.heading: A Caribbean winery
about.p1: Ocoa Bay is one of the few working vineyards in the Caribbean — a coastal estate in the Dominican Republic where sustainable grapes, mango and passion fruit are grown side by side under the same Atlantic sun. The same land you see on the bottle is the land you walk through on the tour.
about.p2: Spend the day. Taste the wines. Eat lunch at the Casa Club. Swim in the pool overlooking the bay. It's the slow side of the Caribbean — and the truest way to understand what makes Dominican wine its own thing.

experiences.heading: Reserve your day at Ocoa Bay
experiences.subheading: Three ways to spend a Saturday or Sunday at the Caribbean's vineyard. Buy your spot through the Kibay shop, then confirm your date directly with the estate.

casaClub.imgAlt: Casa Club at Ocoa Bay — Dominican wines on a dining table overlooking the Caribbean
casaClub.title: Casa Club
casaClub.body: Farm-to-table dining with à la carte minimum consumption. Pool and Casa Club access from 11:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Perfect if you've already toured the vineyard or want a quieter day on the bay.
casaClub.note: Reservations handled directly by Ocoa Bay.

experiences.footnote1: Taxes: 18% ITBIS + 10% by law. Open Saturdays and Sundays only (and holidays). Some product and wine availability varies seasonally.

tasting.heading: Tasting Notes
tasting.subheading: Explore the four wines we craft at Bahía de Ocoa.

wines.name: Rosé
wines.aroma: Bouquet of fresh grape aromas with subtle floral undertones.
wines.flavor: Clean, elegant profile with berry notes; balanced natural sweetness and crisp acidity.
wines.finish: Light to medium-bodied, smooth texture, refreshing finish.

wines.name: Kibay
wines.aroma: Tropical bouquet of ripe mango and zesty chinola citrus.
wines.flavor: Vibrant fusion of exotic flavors: ripe mango and passion fruit with a touch of acidity.
wines.finish: Smooth texture and bright finish; light to medium-bodied.

wines.name: French Colombard
wines.aroma: Fresh, fruity aromas — apple, citrus, floral notes.
wines.flavor: Bright and crisp with high acidity; green apple, pear, citrus, and a tropical touch.
wines.finish: Light to medium-bodied, refreshing due to high acidity.

wines.name: Red Wine
wines.aroma: Ripe grapes, earthy undertones, a gentle hint of spice.
wines.flavor: Ripe grape flavors with subtle spice notes; balanced structure.
wines.finish: Medium-bodied with soft tannins and refreshing acidity.

pairings.heading: Perfect Pairings
pairings.subheading: Elevate your dining experience with our recommendations.
pairings.featureWine: Kibay — tropical wine of mango and passion fruit

items.desc: Kibay's crisp acidity and tropical notes lift raw seafood flavors and the citrus brightness of ceviche.
Soft, creamy cheeses contrast the wine's fruit and cleanse the palate between bites.
Avocado, mango, and citrus-vinaigrette salads echo the wine and complete the Caribbean experience.

booking.heading: Reserve your visit
booking.body: Pick the experience that fits your day, then confirm your date with the Ocoa Bay reservations team. The Caribbean's working vineyard is two hours from Santo Domingo.
